channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Elon Musk says Tesla self-driving makes seniors safer. Tesla’s own fine print says the 93-year-old in its ad must watch the road
item.description: Musk says Tesla self-driving “enables safer mobility” for seniors, but the drivers who need it most may be least able to supervise it.

item.title: Private equity deals in sports doubled in the past two years—investors see it as an ‘institutional-grade asset class,’ Apollo’s Torsten Slok says
item.description: Deals jumped from about 100 a year ago to almost 200 in 2024 and 2025.

item.title: Nvidia degrades U.S. national security as Chinese military snags its chips
item.description: Set aside the scrutiny swirling around Megaspeed. Official endorsements cannot wish away the serious security record piling up in the public view.

item.title: CEO of $21 billion Cerebras says it’s minted 1,000 employees into millionaires—but warns that drastic changes in fortunes can be ‘really stressful’
item.description: Billionaire Cerebras CEO Andrew Feldman said: “Change is stressful, and the vast changes in your personal wealth both up and down are really stressful...
